# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the current `main` branch. CryptoARC is not yet approved for unattended live trading.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not report vulnerabilities through public issues or include credentials, private keys, seed phrases, signed transactions, or personal data in a report.

Use [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting form](https://github.com/AriRosner/CryptoARC-v2/security/advisories/new). Include a concise reproduction, affected commit or version, impact, and any safe mitigation you identified. We will acknowledge a report within 7 days and coordinate remediation before public disclosure.

## Scope

The report should focus on code in this repository and its documented local deployment path. Third-party providers, public blockchains, and user-operated wallets are outside this policy unless the report demonstrates an issue in CryptoARC's integration.
